decisions.statement: The population the run states is the code the roster's add-ons hold.
A field is deferred when the field is published from inside a function body.
A deferred field an add-on's own file assigns at load is not judged.
A name a closure declares of its own shadows the capture and is not judged.
The files the run declined to read are reported beside the files the run read.

definition: the run judging every load-installed hook an add-on on the roster holds
